clause: Clone/heal retouch family: clone stamp, healing brush, spot heal, patch, red-eye [STU-RAS-026]

scope.summary: Implement the non-ML clone-heal retouch primitives as brush-engine tools on pixel layers (and where the source suites allow, on placed-asset layers): Clone stamp (exact pixel copies from a sampled source with aligned sampling, sample-layer scope, cross-document sources, clone-source overlay); Healing brush (samples source/pattern while matching texture/lighting/shading of destination); Spot/blemish heal (single click, auto-samples surrounding texture, no source point); Patch (drag a region over source pixels, normal or content-aware with structure/color adaptation); Red-eye (removes flash reflections with pupil-size/darken, preserving eye detail).
acceptance_criteria: aligned sampling, texture-matching, one-click heal, red-eye proven
proof_targets: clone + heal + spot-heal retouch runtime + before/after snapshot
expected_tests: live: clone-stamp copies sampled pixels with aligned sampling and a clone-source overlay; healing brush blends texture/lighting at the destination via snapshot
live: spot-heal removes a blemish in one click; red-eye reduces red channel in the pupil while preserving detail

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Clone, heal, patch & red-eye

risk_if_missed: No retouching; core photo-editing repair workflows absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
